subject: needle ingested (DR-044) + 2 self-eval items closed + fresh Mac benches + a runner orphan-process finding
body:
Three things from the Mac tonight; all owner-directed ("do everything" + "ingest needle").

1) NEEDLE INGESTED — DR-044 + a RESOURCE_INTAKE row landed (see mainline). cactus-compute/needle evaluated BY USE (isolated venv, base weights, telemetry off) then adversarially hardened by a 4-agent workflow. Verdict: adopted-by-reference as a NARROW offline extraction helper kept on the shelf, base weights only, NEVER on the decision path. It RUNS where LightRAG did not (~48MB warm, 14MB dylib, offline from cache, deterministic per fixed session state). But the workflow corrected several of my first-pass claims and found real surfaces: (a) confidence is a fail-closed GATE (min of calibrated head + decode likelihood), calibrated for BASE only, a CORRECT extraction landed at 0.38 so no threshold cleanly separates right/wrong — it is honest only in the safe direction (no high-confidence-wrong output); (b) extract() DISCARDS the confidence field and finetuning DISABLES the head, so 'calibrate' and 'finetune for our tools' are mutually exclusive; (c) the inference-engine binary's LICENCE is UNVERIFIED (Apache-2.0 covers the wrapper only); (d) no revision= pin on hf_hub_download + pickle.load on fetched artifacts, so "2.0.4" is a filename convention not an integrity pin; (e) .github/workflows/ has a daily-cron PyPI publish + a v*-tag GHCR publish that would auto-execute and collide with our tags if the repo were ever vendored — so NEVER vendor it; (f) two more consent-gated egress paths (OpenRouter data-synth, HF upload). Boundary in DR-044 (golden rule 2 / DR-029): needle's confidence polarity is BACKWARDS for rule 2 (lowers on doubt), and no needle score/extraction/synthetic sample may seed a fixture, rank evidence, feed a figure, or serve as an oracle. Nothing of needle is in the tree.

2) TWO SELF-EVAL AUTONOMOUS ITEMS CLOSED (RESOURCE_INTAKE rows, no shared-file edits): Graphify's semantic-docs pass is DROPPED (not deferred) — doc-semantic retrieval is already the adopted LightRAG key-free naive mode (DR-041), so a second doc-embedding index is redundant; Graphify stays a symbol-level on-demand index. Crucible /temper does NOT join brain-cycle-config.json — the gauntlet's bugHunt already runs /code-review at high/max, so /temper is redundant there; it stays on-demand report-only, hooks off, worktree. brain-cycle-config.json is UNCHANGED.

3) BENCHES RE-RUN ON THE MAC (health signal, NOT a doc edit): bench:decision-latency p95 0.1937ms (mean 0.1353, p50 0.1315, p99 0.2699, max 0.9203; 5000 iters); bench:decision-throughput 7,645 dec/sec single-core, 29,535 dec/sec aggregate on 10 workers, 3.86x scaling, identical verdicts on all 10 workers. Both PASS and deterministic. I did NOT re-date docs/RELIABILITY_SLO.md: its 2026-08-24 table is a COORDINATED single-machine/single-commit measurement (latency + throughput + test:load together) and the doc forbids cross-machine subtraction. This Mac is a different, faster machine class (10-core Apple Silicon; ~5x the 08-24 latency figure), and I only ran 2 of the 3 coordinated benches, so a partial overwrite would break the section's own comparability rule. RECOMMENDATION: the re-date is a coordinated single-machine job (both benches + test:load, one machine, one commit, dated + machine-labelled) — take it as one unit, mine or yours, not a partial edit.

4) ENVIRONMENTAL FINDING for the self-hosted runner: a stale api-server (PID 4293) from the runner's working dir (/Users/danfashauer/actions-runner/_work/.../artifacts/api-server/dist/index.mjs) was squatting port 5310 for 4h26m — orphaned from a killed job that never cleaned up its ephemeral test server. It made the LOCAL api:test crash (its fresh server couldn't bind 5310, so the test hit the stale old-build server whose /v1/keys lacked the current shape). Killed it; test:api then 409/409. The mac-runner-harness should SIGKILL leftover dist/index.mjs on port 5310 at job start/teardown, or the next local/CI api:test on this box fails the same way.
